title: Cylinder
spec: Create a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero and a translation vector also set to zero. For the first face, draw a circle with a center at (0.0363, 0.0363) and a radius of 0.0363. In the second loop, draw another circle with the same center but a radius of 0.0342. Scale the entire two-dimensional sketch by a factor of 0.0725. Rotate the scaled sketch using the same Euler angles and translate it using the same translation vector. Extrude the sketch along the normal direction by 0.75 units to create a solid body. Ensure that the extrusion does not occur in the opposite direction of the normal. The resulting cylindrical object will have a flat top and bottom, a central axis, and a uniform diameter throughout its length. The final dimensions of the cylinder are 0.07254375 units in both width and length, and 0.75 units in height.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Define the initial coordinate system
workplane = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Create the sketch for the base of the cylinder
sketch = (
    workplane
    .center(0.0363, 0.0363)  # Move to the center of the circle
    .circle(0.0363)  # Outer circle
    .circle(0.0342)  # Inner circle
)

# Extrude the sketch to create the cylinder
cylinder = sketch.extrude(0.75)

# Assign the final model to 'r'
r = cylinder
